summary: Iteration 4 tested end-to-end. Backend: 16/16 pytest passing (100%) covering: /api/geo/search (Paris returns results with name/region/country/lat/lon; q<2 chars returns empty; auth required); /api/profile/race-location (valid save returns ok+race_location, invalid lat -> 422, invalid lon -> 422); /api/race/weather (thomas@pace.app returns status='difficult' with race_date, days_left=2, goal_label='Semi-marathon', race_location=Annecy, forecast{temp_min/max, wind_max_kmh, rain_prob, condition, icon, weather_code}, flags=['chaleur'], and non-empty Claude strategy text; second call cached and fast <8s; auth required); /api/coach/route-weather?lat=45.9&lon=6.13 (returns route in {r1..r6} with 'terrain' field, French reason>15c, wind_tip, weather{condition,temperature_c,wind_kmh,wind_dir,icon}; cached second call <5s; invalid coords -> 422; auth required); regression /api/weather now exposes current.wind_dir_deg. Frontend (mobile 390x844): logged in as thomas@pace.app, Home shows 'ALERTE MÉTÉO COURSE' (race-weather-card) with 'J-2 · Semi-marathon à Annecy', forecast row (Couvert · 12–27°C · vent 6 km/h · pluie 0%), 'chaleur' flag pill, tapping 'race-strategy-toggle' expands 1424-char Claude strategy in 'race-strategy-text'. Pencil (race-edit-city) opens modal, typing 'Lyon' in 'race-city-input' produces 'race-city-result-0' (Lyon, Rhône-Alpes · France); selecting it saves and card reloads to 'Semi-marathon à Lyon, Rhône-Alpes' within ~2s. Explore tab shows 'Circuit selon la météo' CTA (route-weather-cta) — clicking on headless web produces no suggestion (expected, geolocation unavailable). Route list route-r1..route-r6 all render, filter-easy correctly hides route-r2 (intervals). Restored race_location to Annecy after tests to avoid state pollution.
action_items: No new issues found in iteration 4. Prior known caveat (deep-link/hard-reload 401 due to in-memory token in src/api.ts) from iteration_3 remains — not exercised by iteration 4 flows but still open.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py /api/geo/search: correctly returns empty results for q<2 chars, requires auth, and maps Open-Meteo geocoding fields to name/region/country/lat/lon — good.
server.py /api/profile/race-location: manual 422 for out-of-range lat/lon; also invalidates db.race_alerts so next /api/race/weather re-generates strategy for the new city — good UX.

server.py /api/race/weather: sensible state machine (no_race / past / need_location / too_far / ok / difficult), flags derived from apparent temp/wind/rain/weather_code (STORM/HEAVY_PRECIP), Claude strategy cached per (user, race_date, day) in db.race_alerts — good.
server.py /api/coach/route-weather: 1h cache in db.route_tips per user, JSON-only Claude prompt with catalog terrain descriptors, wind_dir_deg -> French compass label — clean.
RaceWeatherCard.tsx: debounced geo search (400ms), reload after city save, notifications scheduling gated behind Platform.OS !== 'web' — correct.
The route-weather cache is keyed only by user_id (not lat/lon). If a user changes location within the hour, they will keep the previous city's suggestion. Low priority, worth noting.
seed_data_creation: None — used pre-seeded thomas@pace.app (race_date J+2, race_location=Annecy). Restored Annecy at end of frontend run to keep state.
